tagline: Helping people care for what matters most to them
hero_kpi_rationale: The generation of €2.1 billion in operating capital highlights the group's ability to create sustainable financial value for its shareholders while maintaining exceptional financial strength (Solvency II ratio at 220%).

kpis.name: Operating Capital Generation
kpis.explanation: The company's ability to generate capital from its core operations, a key performance indicator for insurers.
kpis.description: NN Group generated €2.1 billion in operating capital in 2025, demonstrating the strength of its business model and its capacity to create value.
kpis.signal: Robust capital generation reflecting strong operational execution.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated after all operating and investment expenditures, available for shareholders.
kpis.description: Free cash flow amounted to €1.6 billion in 2025, confirming the group's ability to generate liquidity for investors.
kpis.signal: Strong cash flow enabling attractive shareholder distributions.

kpis.name: Solvency II Ratio
kpis.explanation: Regulatory measure of an insurer's financial strength, expressing available own funds relative to capital requirements.
kpis.description: NN Group reports a Solvency II ratio of 220% in 2025, reflecting remarkable financial strength and prudent capital management.
kpis.signal: Exceptional capital position, well above regulatory requirements.

kpis.name: Climate Solutions Investments
kpis.explanation: Total amount invested in solutions contributing to climate transition and environmental sustainability.
kpis.description: NN Group has invested €13.7 billion in climate solutions, demonstrating its tangible commitment to sustainability.
kpis.signal: Major commitment to climate transition through the investment portfolio.

kpis.name: Customers
kpis.explanation: Total number of customers served by the group across its various markets and products.
kpis.description: NN Group serves approximately 18 million customers in Europe and Japan through its pension, insurance, banking, and investment products.
kpis.signal: Large and diversified customer base across Europe and Japan.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the group.
kpis.description: NN Group employs approximately 16,000 employees across its operations in Europe and Japan.
kpis.signal: Organization scaled to serve 18 million customers across 10 countries.

kpis.name: Gender Diversity (senior management)
kpis.explanation: Proportion of women in senior management positions within the organization.
kpis.description: Women represent 58% of senior management positions at NN Group, reflecting an inclusive and balanced culture.
kpis.signal: Female majority in senior leadership roles, demonstrating a strong commitment to diversity.

kpis.name: Digital Customer Interaction (Netherlands)
kpis.explanation: Percentage of customer interactions conducted via digital channels in the Netherlands.
kpis.description: 77% of customer interactions in the Netherlands occurred via digital channels at year-end 2025 (annual average of 73%).
kpis.signal: Advanced digital transformation with over three-quarters of interactions online.

kpis.name: Data & AI Use Cases
kpis.explanation: Number of operational use cases leveraging data analytics and artificial intelligence.
kpis.description: NN Group has deployed 236 Data & AI use cases across its organization, demonstrating mature adoption of advanced technologies.
kpis.signal: Widespread deployment of AI and analytics to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.

kpis.name: Digital Sales (International)
kpis.explanation: Percentage of sales originating from leads generated through digital channels in international markets.
kpis.description: 42% of international sales come from digitally generated leads, illustrating the effectiveness of digital strategies.
kpis.signal: Growing effectiveness of digital marketing in driving sales.

kpis.name: Employee Engagement
kpis.explanation: Score measuring employee engagement and satisfaction levels.
kpis.description: NN Group reports an employee engagement score of 8 out of 10, reflecting a positive corporate culture.
kpis.signal: High employee engagement, a key driver of operational performance.

kpis.name: Community Impact
kpis.explanation: Cumulative number of people supported through community programs since 2022.
kpis.description: NN Group has contributed to supporting 1.39 million people through its community programs (cumulative since 2022).
kpis.signal: Significant social impact through community initiatives.

kpis.name: Dividends Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividends per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividends per share of €3.54 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of €0.939 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Proportion of net income distributed as dividends: 79.0% in the latest year.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned at the beginning of the detailed section (5.1), material impact language ('decrease in Solvency II Own Funds'), upward trend (SCR increased from €1,163 to €1,480 million), Capital category heavily weighted in the solvency ratio.

risks.title: Credit Spread Risk
risks.score_rationale: Major risk with SCR of €4,065 million (2025), significant 11% increase compared to 2024 (€3,659 million), material impact language on own funds, credit category critical for insurers.

risks.title: Internal Model Risk
risks.score_rationale: Positioned early in the report (section 4.2), explicit language on inherent risk ('carry an inherent risk that the developed models include aspects which might be less appropriate'), stable but structural risk, internal models critical for capital calculation.

risks.title: Real Estate Portfolio Risk
risks.score_rationale: Real estate exposure of €11.79 billion (8% of portfolio), real estate SCR stable at €1,909 million, significant market risk but geographically well diversified, stable trend.

risks.title: Mortgage Portfolio Risk
risks.score_rationale: Major mortgage exposure of €57.4 billion (37% of portfolio), combined credit and interest rate risk, stable portfolio but high concentration, stable trend.

risks.title: Operational Risk
risks.score_rationale: Operational SCR stable at €535 million (2025 vs €567 million in 2024), neutral language ('broadly stable'), decreasing risk, operational category less critical than capital/credit.

risks.title: Counterparty Risk
risks.score_rationale: Counterparty SCR very low and stable (€115 million in 2025 vs €112 million in 2024), neutral language ('Stable Counterparty default risk SCR'), minor risk in overall profile, stable trend.

ai_positioning.summary: NN Group positions artificial intelligence and data analytics as major strategic levers in its digital transformation. With 236 deployed Data & AI use cases, the group demonstrates mature and operational adoption of these technologies to enhance customer experience and organizational efficiency.

77% of customer interactions in the Netherlands occur via digital channels
42% of international sales originate from digitally generated leads
Explicit focus on 'Digital & Data-driven' transformation as a strategic pillar
